messages:
TEAM~MAGMA~COURTNEY sent out
Torkoal and Gastrodon!
Ludicolo lost some of its HP!

A tailwind started blowing
on your side!

The opposing Torkoal flinched
and couldn’t move!

The opposing Gastrodon
took the attack!
It’s not very effective on Pelipper.

The opposing Gastrodon had
its energy drained!
Ludicolo lost some of its HP!

The harsh sunlight activated
the opposing Great~Tusk

The opposing Great~Tusk’s
Attack was heightened!

Swampert’s Swampertite is reacting
to BRENDAN’s Mega

Swampert has Mega Evolved
into Mega Swampert!

The opposing Pyroar has Mega
Evolved into Mega Pyroa

The opposing Turtonator returned its
stats to normal
